dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: You got either couples flirting, or someone pushing fliers on choir, card games, cross country, and other events on you in the study.

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: I could have just stayed in the dorm room, but my dumb roommate tried to make hotpot with a prototype burner...

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: I won't go into details, except the room is still full of smoke.

dialogues.speaker: Ziryab
dialogues.text: I don't trust myself to write anything Hana will appreciate in that condition.
